title: Quantization fingerprinting and stability harness for staged pinning
creator: Ava Chen
description:
Problem: We onboard many low-precision model variants (INT8, FP8, GPTQ, AWQ) from partners and open-source contributors. Current pinning flows accept a quant profile artifact and expose throughput/latency numbers, but we lack a compact fingerprint and stability harness that lets us automatically group similar variants, detect subtle quality regressions across traffic slices, and create an automated staged-pinning workflow.

Goal: Implement a deterministic quantization fingerprint and a stability harness that enables: (1) clustering of incoming quant artifacts for dedup/pin-recommendations, (2) nightly synthetic microbench canaries that stress KV/cache and branching code paths, (3) delta-based regression detection for both latency/throughput and quality (NLL/LM-ACL/embedding drift), and (4) an automated staged-pinning suggestion in the Console with clear rollback thresholds.

Scope: Build the fingerprint generator (binary + metadata hash), a lightweight canary runner that executes microbenchmarks across representative sequence-length buckets and cache warm states, telemetry contracts for the fingerprint and canary runs, and CI gating rules to prevent promoting artifacts that exceed regression thresholds. This ticket focuses on engineering the harness and telemetry; UX work for Console suggestions will be a follow-up work item.

Non-goals: No changes to model conversion pipelines (that remains in infra team), and this ticket will not implement policy-driven automatic rollouts (only recommend and flag).
acceptance_criteria: Fingerprint function produces stable 64-bit hex fingerprint for the same quant artifact and changes on meaningful weight/param/precision differences
Daily synthetic canary job runs with 3 sequence-length buckets (32/256/2048) and both cold/warm KV states; output uploaded to quant-canary dashboard
Regression detector emits alerts when latency increases >10% p50 or >15% p99 vs baseline, throughput drops >12%, or quality delta exceeds thresholds (per-metric thresholds in telemetry_contract doc)
CI gate prevents promoting artifacts with high-severity regression flags and posts a JIRA-style comment with exact failure signals and a link to the canary trace
Documentation: Confluence doc describing fingerprint algorithm, canary scenarios, telemetry mapping, and instructions for manual rerun and investigation
steps: Design fingerprint: combine quant manifest fields (dtype profile, shard layout, q-op map) and a canonicalized weight checksum; implement in Rust shim used by intake service
Create canary microbench harness: workloads for 32/256/2048 sequence lengths, mix of generation and chat prefix workloads, include cold KV (new session) and warm KV (resumed session)
Define telemetry_contract: metric names, tags (artifact_id, fingerprint, model_family, quant_type, seq_bucket), and thresholds; add to runtime-1.24 telemetry schema
Implement nightly runner in Kubernetes CronJob and a fast on-demand test endpoint for devs to trigger canaries for a single artifact
Hook canary outputs into the quant-canary Grafana dashboard and create alerting rules in PagerDuty/Slack channels
Add CI gate: a lightweight step in quant-publish pipeline that runs short canary subset and fails publish if regressions flagged
Write Confluence guide and a short troubleshooting checklist for SRE and ML onboarding engineers
regression_signals: Latency: p50 increase > 10% OR p99 increase > 15% vs artifact baseline
Throughput: sustained < 88% of baseline across a 1-minute window
Quality: NLL delta > 0.08 on standard eval set OR embedding cosine drift > 0.04
Stability: failing >3 of 10 synthetic seeds for stochastic quant variants
Resource: peak memory > +15% of baseline or OOMs during canary
rollout_plan: Recommend stage: internal-beta -> limited-customer-canary -> public-pin. For each stage, run full canary suite with production traffic shadowing. Manual approval required for stage progression if any regression signals present. Default automatic rollback to previous pinned variant on critical signals.

2026-03-03 - Mateo Rivera: Spike complete for fingerprint: using BLAKE3 over canonicalized shard byte stream + JSON manifest fields gave stable 64-bit truncation. Prototype code at PR #842. Observed collision risk < 1e-12 in sample set of 5k artifacts.

2026-03-05 - Priya Nair (SRE): Canary runner design reviewed. Concern: running warm KV workloads at scale will double GPU cost for nightly runs. Proposed mixed approach: short warm runs in nightly, full warm runs on-demand for pin candidates.

2026-03-06 - Mateo Rivera: Implemented canary harness with 3 seq buckets and both cold/warm toggles. Uploaded initial metrics to a temporary dashboard. Noticed that AWQ variants have 20-30% higher p99 under cold KV — flagged as potential perf regression pattern.
2026-03-08 - Ava Chen: Telemetry contract drafted and uploaded to runtime schema repo. Added tags for model_family and quant_type. Set preliminary thresholds after consulting ML evaluation team.

2026-03-10 - Design review by Lina Park: requested a short UX follow-up to expose the fingerprint and canary summary in the Console pin modal. Created follow-up PM ticket PM-1987 for Console integration.

2026-03-10 - Mateo Rivera: Pushed CI gate step to experimental branch; it runs a 30s short canary and annotates the quant publish PR. Next: add more robust failure messages and link back to full canary traces.
